mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_daily_stats(user_id, quiz_date, total_questions, correct_answers) VALUES(#{userId}, CURDATE(), 1, #{correct} = true) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_questions = total_questions + 1, correct_answers = correct_answers + (#{correct} = true)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM quiz_daily_stats WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND quiz_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) ORDER BY quiz_date ASC
